title: ivcbench: An Immune-Aware Benchmark of Perturbation-Prediction Generalization
description: Revision package v1.2.2 for Toward Immune Virtual Cells (Lee and Ryu; BIB-26-1553). The panel contains 47 evaluations: 35 native, six adapted and six diagnostic. This editorially polished snapshot preserves the validated scientific results, symmetric mean-profile program targets, identity controls, target-matched repeatability and comparison-specific precision statements. CPU replay verifies Pearson-delta from 1,362 selected mean bundles; it does not reconstruct cell distributions or retrain models. Native chemCPA supplies the held-compound CPA/chemCPA result. Non-native CPA/scGen and wrongly recovered STATE T3/T4/T5 executions remain excluded; STATE T1/T2 remain. Soskic results concern supplied residualized coordinates. Source data, figures, document builders and execution provenance accompany the package.
